correctness.rationale: For every finite nonempty simple base G and every choice (R,L), initially unobserved roots U retain white private leaves, preventing those roots or other non-agent roots from forcing additional original vertices. Exactly \(A=L\setminus R\) can each force at most one member of U. A successful force order gives an upper-triangular matched-agent/target adjacency matrix, so a uniquely restricted target-saturating matching exists; its acyclic alternating-dependency digraph conversely supplies legal sink-first forces. Every remaining private leaf is then forced. On a forest base, the relevant bipartite graph is a forest and any matching is uniquely restricted. The 128-state tree recursion accurately records child-root selected flags, parent-selected contexts and Boolean feasibility of zero or one crossing matching edge; a target requires precisely one incident matched edge and an agent at most one. Each selected subset has a unique deterministic state and contributes its weight once, independent of the number of matchings. Direct exhaustive verification over 208 graph representatives up to order six and 676900 initial subsets agreed with an independent uniquely restricted matching search, and all 42 forest representatives agreed coefficientwise with the recursion. These tests corroborate, not prove, infinite-order conclusions; no nonstandard external lemma is assumed without proof beyond Hall's theorem and elementary matching-cycle facts.

The most closely related later fully inspected arXiv:2201.09111 counts complete m-ary rooted trees, not leaf coronas of arbitrary forests, and does not imply the exact unique-matching characterization or constant-width coefficient recurrence. The 2001 uniquely restricted matching definition is credited as prior. Searches for aliases, stronger coverage, tables and equivalent implications in published research records and primary sources found only adjacent-domain results; finite tables and minimum-set enumerators do not subsume the new result. value.rationale: Brimkov et al. explicitly posed computation of the power-domination polynomial for the private-leaf corona as an open direction. The theorem answers a natural substantial subclass, every forest base without degree bounds, and determines all cardinalities rather than a minimum parameter. The witness distinction between Hall matchability and unique restriction is structural and necessary, as shown by the alternating four-cycle obstruction; the no-even-cycle subclass admits a sharp Hall criterion. The deterministic fixed-size interface transforms a global iterative propagation property into a reproducible polynomial-time exact enumerator. The class includes arbitrary branching, isolates, and disconnected components; no arbitrary slicing, table recomputation, or unsupported downstream significance is used.
